purpose: Add a restrained, natural English launch-film narrator to the human-approved 32.9-second Grifon film. Curious opening, confident pivot and closing. Preserve approved picture and action SFX.
provider: ElevenLabs direct API, existing desktop account

request.text:
Your next ad.
To launch a product.
To tell your story.
To grow your business.
But there's never time to make it.
Until now.
Meet Grifon.
Find the angle. Build the story.
Give your next ad a clear direction.
Research. Script. Storyboard.
Grifon dot A I.

pronunciation.target: GRIFF-on for Grifon; A and I spoken as separate letter names.
pronunciation.limitation: Target is an audition criterion, not a guaranteed API pronunciation. No identity cloning, dictionary or phonetic respelling is submitted.

budget.creditEvidence: Stock premade voice; read-only model catalog on 2026-10-03 reports tokenCostFactor=1, character_cost_multiplier=1, cost_discount_multiplier=1.
budget.accountBalance: Unknown: the existing API key received HTTP 401 for read-only subscription data. No dollar conversion or remaining balance is asserted.
budget.retryPolicy: No automatic retries or paid alignment calls. Mark the single attempt consumed before POST; timeout/unknown outcome also consumes it. New input, casting, model or second request needs a new approved spec.

segments.text: But there's never time to make it.

editing.timingPolicy: Use returned character timestamps to place whole phrases in these windows, including breath/consonant handles. Keep natural duration where possible; stop for a timing failure instead of clipping words or exceeding tempo cap.
editing.bedReconstruction: Subtract the approved SFX stem, including its existing tail fade, from the approved mix premaster. This retains the authored music filtering and envelopes. Duck only recovered music; SFX contacts are not shifted.
editing.export: New grifon-full-upgrade-english-vo-1080p.mp4; copy the accepted H264 video stream. Re-encode the new full mix as stereo AAC48k with faststart. Keep approved no-VO exports untouched.

passFail: Exactly one provider synthesis request, exact approved body, credit estimate no higher than 500; no rerolls.
All eleven phrases present with usable timestamps, no clipped speech, no phrase outside its window and no tempo greater than 1.12.
Speech remains audible above the music; music-only ducking leaves original SFX samples and contacts unchanged.
Voice finishes before the 31.96-second visual fade. Final black tail remains silent.
Output is 1920x1080, 30fps, 987 frames, 32.900 seconds, H264yuv420p, stereo AAC48k, fully decodable with identical H264 payload to the approved film.
Encoded mix measures -16 LUFS +/-1 and true peak no higher than -1 dBTP.
Human audition required for premium delivery, clear wording, GRIFF-on and separate A/I pronunciation. Technical measurements cannot substitute for listening.
